subject: Sponsor handoff + link rotation grid for April 18 webinar
messages:
From: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jenna Ortiz <jenna@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 09:13:00 -0700
Subject: Sponsor handoff + link rotation grid for April 18 webinar

Team / Jenna —

Quick sync to hand off sponsor logistics and the tracking/link rotation plan for the April 18 "Scaling Inference" webinar (60 min). High level asks:

- Confirm final sponsor panel (Acme + CloudBridge) and final logo files by EOD Friday.
- Approve tracking link rotation matrix so we can publish personalized links for registrants and sponsors.
- Decide who will own sponsor UTM reporting in HubSpot (ops or partner team).

Attached is the first pass of a link rotation grid (link_rotation_grid_v2.csv) — column notes in the sheet. Key constraints: we need unique sponsor landing links + one shared fallback link for organic traffic. Marissa: can you review copy variants (two CTA lines) and add short copy for sponsor co-mail? Vivek: want your take on the hotlist logic (priority send to field). Jenna — looping you to confirm the Acme logo lockup and preferred redirect domains.

Proposed next steps (this week):
- Today: Marissa & Vivek review grid and add comments to the Drive doc.
- Thu: Finalize links and push to tracking sheet.
- Fri: Sponsor assets collected; apply to Portal + send proof to Jenna for signoff.

Meeting if needed: I can host a 30-min handoff Thu 11a PT.

Thanks,
Michael Grant
Head of Field Marketing (Events)
Redwood Inference

Attachments: link_rotation_grid_v2.csv
Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-link/link-rotations

From: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
To: Michael Grant <michael.grant@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>, Jenna Ortiz <jenna@acmecorp.com>
Cc: Stephanie Nguyen <stephanie.nguyen@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Mar 2028 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Sponsor handoff + link rotation grid for April 18 webinar

Thanks Michael — added the copy variants and a short sponsor co-mail draft into the Drive doc (see tab "Copy v1"). Notes:

- Two CTA variants: "Reserve your spot" (neutral) and "See Acme's demo" (sponsor-forward). Recommend A/B test subject lines across a 10k seed.
- For sponsor landing links we should append: ?sponsor=acme&utm_source=partner_email&utm_campaign=webinar_apr18 to preserve attribution.
- I updated the grid with a suggested 3-day stagger for hotlist sends; Vivek, flag if that collides with Dedicated capacity reservations.

I attached a quick export of the grid with comments so Jenna can see the mapping without Drive access: link_rotation_grid_v2.csv (tabbed). Also adding a checklist for assets needed from Acme and CloudBridge.

Cheers,
Marissa Cole
Sr. Events Marketing Manager
Redwood Inference

Thanks for the clear plan. Quick answers from Acme:

- We'll sponsor the demo segment and provide the senior architect (Shane Park) as the panelist.
- I'll attach logos and our preferred lockup in a zip by EOD Thursday — sending them as sponsor_logo_pack.zip.
- Billing: please route the sponsorship invoice to finance@acmecorp.com (CC me).

Perfect — Jenna, thanks for the quick turnaround. Answers:

- Acme-specific redirect: yes, we can map acme.acmecorp.com/redwood-webinar as a sponsor vanity. Marissa will add the redirect column to the grid and I will open a ticket with infra to reserve the domain.
- CTA: we'll default the initial send to the sponsor-forward CTA as requested. We'll still include the neutral CTA in the footer for non-sponsor traffic.
- Billing: noted (finance@acmecorp.com). We'll include invoice contact on the sponsor agreement.

Action items: 
- Marissa: add redirect column + final CTA copy.
- Vivek: confirm hotlist priority window and any downstream Dedicated capacity constraints.
- Stephanie: I'll need a proof email and tracking link proof to send to Jenna after assets are uploaded.

I'll grab Thu 3p PT for the quick align call — sending a calendar invite now.

Thanks all,
Michael
